a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical accepted-boundary completeness rubric to the packet
missing boundary context does not block review dispatch or approval

cases.name: No binding scope source can be omitted from review

definitions.text: a child plan is bound by ticket scope, ticket exclusions, project non-goals, milestone non-goals, and inherited parent boundaries and its review packet includes every structurally required role and path but the supplied ticket context omits its positive scope
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical accepted-boundary completeness rubric to the packet
review cannot approve and names the missing ticket scope

cases.name: The installed Implementation Plan gate enforces binding scope context

definitions.text: an Implementation Plan in the installed Claude Code workflow has a review packet that contains every binding scope source
actual lifecycle dispatch from installed local project hooks runs its judged Implementation Plan review with real configuration and collaborators, mocking only non-reviewer process boundaries
Implementation Plan review dispatch proceeds

cases.name: The installed Implementation Plan gate enforces binding scope context

definitions.text: an Implementation Plan in the installed Claude Code workflow has a review packet that omits the project non-goals
actual lifecycle dispatch from installed local project hooks runs its judged Implementation Plan review with real configuration and collaborators, mocking only non-reviewer process boundaries
Implementation Plan approval remains blocked with the missing project boundary named

cases.name: Plan completeness is bidirectional

definitions.text: an accepted boundary requires authorization and excludes automatic account migration and the plan omits authorization behavior
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical bidirectional scope-completeness rubric to the plan
approval is blocked with the in-scope omission named

cases.name: Plan completeness is bidirectional

definitions.text: an accepted boundary requires authorization and excludes automatic account migration and the plan includes automatic account migration
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical bidirectional scope-completeness rubric to the plan
approval is blocked with the out-of-scope proposal named

cases.name: Plan completeness is bidirectional

definitions.text: an accepted boundary requires authorization and excludes automatic account migration and the plan decides authorization and excludes account migration
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical bidirectional scope-completeness rubric to the plan
scope completeness does not block approval

Implementation Plan approval proceeds

actual lifecycle dispatch from installed local project hooks runs its judged Implementation Plan review with real configuration and collaborators, mocking only non-reviewer process boundaries

actual lifecycle dispatch from installed local project hooks runs its judged Implementation Plan review with real configuration and collaborators, mocking only non-reviewer process boundaries
Implementation Plan approval remains blocked with the overreach named

cases.name: Optional strengthening changes only through user authority

definitions.text: a nonblocking reviewer suggestion for a useful capability outside the accepted boundary is recorded
the user declines it
the unchanged plan is re-reviewed against the accepted boundary and the decline remains recorded

cases.name: Optional strengthening changes only through user authority

definitions.text: a nonblocking reviewer suggestion for a useful capability outside the accepted boundary is recorded
the user accepts it
the expansion is recorded as user-accepted before the plan is corrected and re-reviewed

cases.name: An undecided optional suggestion cannot alter or block the plan

definitions.text: a nonblocking suggestion outside the accepted boundary awaits a user decision
the unchanged plan is re-reviewed while that decision remains outstanding
the reviewed plan bytes remain unchanged, the gate does not block on or silently add the suggestion, and the outstanding choice is re-presented for the user to decide

cases.name: Installed re-review retains a declined optional strengthening

definitions.text: the user recorded a decline for an optional strengthening under the current accepted boundary and left the plan unchanged
a later judged re-review runs through installed local project hooks with real configuration and collaborators, mocking only non-reviewer process boundaries
the decline is supplied to the reviewer, the suggestion remains nonblocking, and any approval is recorded against the unchanged plan bytes

cases.name: Guidance respects the accepted boundary

definitions.text: a recorded architecture, data, testing, domain, or research suggestion proposes a decision required by accepted behavior
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical accepted-boundary guidance rubric to the suggestion
the decision is surfaced and resolved in its owning plan

cases.name: Guidance respects the accepted boundary

definitions.text: a recorded architecture, data, testing, domain, or research suggestion proposes an unrelated capability whose exclusion does not change the accepted outcome
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical accepted-boundary guidance rubric to the suggestion
the capability is dropped

cases.name: Guidance respects the accepted boundary

definitions.text: a recorded architecture, data, testing, domain, or research suggestion proposes a capability outside accepted behavior whose exclusion would change the accepted outcome
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical accepted-boundary guidance rubric to the suggestion
the capability is surfaced as a user-owned scope choice and does not enter the plan

cases.name: Product Plan approval requires every accepted persona outcome

definitions.text: the Product Plan accepts a Technical Builder and a Non-Technical Builder and inventories every accepted persona's consequential success, refusal, failure, approval, trust, and recovery outcomes
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical Product Plan completeness rubric
persona-outcome completeness does not block Product Plan approval

cases.name: Product Plan approval requires every accepted persona outcome

definitions.text: the Product Plan accepts a Technical Builder and a Non-Technical Builder and marks the Non-Technical Builder's approval outcome explicitly inapplicable with a stated reason and inventories the rest
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical Product Plan completeness rubric
persona-outcome completeness does not block Product Plan approval

cases.name: Product Plan approval requires every accepted persona outcome

definitions.text: the Product Plan accepts a Technical Builder and a Non-Technical Builder and omits the Non-Technical Builder's recovery outcome
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical Product Plan completeness rubric
Product Plan approval is blocked naming that missing recovery outcome and reports no scenario-coverage verdict

cases.name: Product Plan approval requires honest epistemic status

definitions.text: the Product Plan contains known facts, assumptions, and unresolved product decisions and presents an assumption as a known fact
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical Product Plan completeness rubric
Product Plan approval is blocked with the epistemic-status defect named

cases.name: Product Plan approval requires honest epistemic status

definitions.text: the Product Plan contains known facts, assumptions, and unresolved product decisions and keeps known facts, assumptions, and unresolved product decisions distinct
a judged semantic reviewer evaluation applies the canonical Product Plan completeness rubric
epistemic status does not block Product Plan approval

cases.name: Scenario review proves every applicable persona outcome

definitions.text: an approved Product Plan persona-outcome inventory has at least one accepted scenario for every applicable outcome
the scenario gate evaluates behavior coverage
scenario coverage does not block approval

cases.name: Scenario review proves every applicable persona outcome

definitions.text: an approved Product Plan persona-outcome inventory has no accepted scenario for the Non-Technical Builder recovery outcome
the scenario gate evaluates behavior coverage
scenario approval is blocked with that uncovered recovery outcome named
